# UVIK

> > UVIK is a global staff augmentation firm specializing in Python, AI/ML, and data engineering talent with 48-hour hiring and flexible engagement models.

Founded in 2015, UVIK provides offshore and nearshore staff augmentation services across web development, generative AI, data science, and cloud infrastructure. The platform connects enterprises with dedicated developers across Python, JavaScript, DevOps, and emerging AI technologies.

## Key Topics

- Python Development
- Generative AI & LLMs
- Django & Flask Frameworks
- Machine Learning & Deep Learning
- Data Engineering & Data Science
- Full Stack Development
- React & React Native
- DevOps & AWS
- REST APIs & Backend Development
- Blockchain Development
- Staff Augmentation
- Remote Hiring
- Dedicated Developers
- 48-Hour Onboarding
- Flexible Engagement Models

## Generative AI & Consulting Services

- [Generative AI Consulting](https://uvik.net/services/generative-ai-consulting): UVIK's generative AI consulting services with strategy, integration, and LLM expertise.
- [Generative AI Development](https://uvik.net/services/generative-ai-development): Custom generative AI development using GPT, Llama, and other LLM technologies.
- [Data Science Consulting](https://uvik.net/services/data-science): Data science consulting with ML, NLP, and business intelligence expertise.
